record.field: Audit & Current-State Discovery

Review the Meta Business Manager, WhatsApp Business Account, Facebook Page, Instagram account, Odoo 19 WhatsApp app configuration, Odoo email configuration, and every permission granted to the Meta app/System User. Produce a findings note before changing anything.
A clear picture of exactly what is connected, what is broken, and why, before anything is changed.
Meta Business Manager Verification & Ownership Cleanup

Resolve any pending or failed Meta Business verification; confirm the client holds primary admin ownership of the Business Portfolio, Page, Instagram account and WABA; clean up asset assignment so all assets sit in the one correct Business Portfolio.
A Business Portfolio that is verified, correctly owned, and holding the right assets.
WhatsApp Business Platform Setup with Mobile-App Coexistence

Confirm the client's WABA and phone number are eligible for coexistence between the mobile app and the Cloud API under Meta's current rules; register the number for Cloud API access following the coexistence-specific flow; verify the mobile WhatsApp Business app still works on the same number.
WhatsApp connected to Odoo via the Cloud API, with the existing mobile app still usable on the same number.
Odoo WhatsApp App Configuration

Configure the WhatsApp integration with the WABA ID, phone number ID and System User token; configure and verify the webhook (URL reachable from Meta, verify token matching, subscription fields); send and receive real test messages; confirm status updates flow back; confirm at least one approved template sends end to end.
Odoo correctly authenticated against the WhatsApp Business Platform, sending and receiving reliably.
Facebook Page & Instagram Business Connection

Confirm the Instagram account is a genuine Business/Professional account; link it to the correct Facebook Page; confirm the Page is assigned to the cleaned-up Business Portfolio with the right admin roles; confirm Page/Instagram messaging permissions and test real inbound messages.
The Page and Instagram account correctly linked to each other and to the right Business Portfolio.
Permissions, Tokens & App Review

Inventory every permission granted to the Meta app/System User and remove anything broader than needed; use a long-lived System User token; if App Review is required, submit only the genuinely required permissions; document token ownership and renewal responsibility.
Exactly the access needed, correctly scoped, documented and renewable without guesswork.
Email Integration Configuration

Configure the outgoing mail server for the business domain and test sending from a real record; configure incoming mail handling (catch-all/alias routing); check SPF/DKIM deliverability fundamentals; confirm WhatsApp and email channels are clearly identifiable on the customer timeline.
Odoo sending and receiving business email reliably, alongside the WhatsApp/Meta work.
End-to-End Testing & Validation

Run a full real-world test across WhatsApp (API and mobile app), email, Page and Instagram; deliberately test a failure path (invalid/expired token); have the client send real test messages from their own phone and from Odoo; re-confirm the mobile app constraint held throughout.
Every connection proven working together, not just individually.
Documentation, Handover & Ongoing Maintenance

Write a plain-language summary of the final Meta/Odoo structure; document what needs periodic attention and how often; hand over admin ownership of every Meta asset and Odoo credential to the client; provide a troubleshooting quick-reference.
The client can maintain this setup, or brief a future developer, without re-discovering everything from scratch.
